title: $\Spec LC(S,\Z)$ is weakly étale over $\Spec\Z$
statement:
Let $S$ be a profinite set and let $LC(S,\Z)$ be the ring of locally constant
functions $S\to\Z$. Then the morphism $\Spec LC(S,\Z)\to\Spec\Z$ is weakly
étale ([def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]).

proof.text: Put $B=LC(S,\Z)$. Let $\mathcal P$ be the set of finite partitions of $S$ into nonempty clopen subsets, ordered by refinement, with an arrow from a coarser to a finer partition. For $S=\varnothing$ include its empty partition. This is a small nonempty directed poset: $\{S\}$ is a partition when $S\ne\varnothing$, and the nonempty intersections of blocks of two partitions form a common refinement. Set $B_P=\Z^P$ and send $a\in B_P$ to the function $j_P(a)$ whose value on the block $U\in P$ is $a(U)$. These are injective unital ring maps, since every block is nonempty, including the unique map between zero rings when $S$ is empty. Refinement $Q\ge P$ induces $B_P\to B_Q$ by repeating a value on all subblocks; these maps commute with the $j_P$. For $f\in B$, its nonempty fibres form a disjoint open cover of $S$. Compactness gives a finite subcover, hence there are finitely many nonempty fibres, each also closed because its complement is a union of other open fibres. Thus $f$ is in the image of some $j_P$.

source.place: First paragraph: finite values and factorization through finite quotients, made explicit by clopen partitions

proof.text: The cocone $(B,j_P)$ is the filtered colimit of the $B_P$ in commutative $\Z$-algebras, using the universal property in [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Indeed, for any compatible family $h_P:B_P\to C$, define $h(f)=h_P(a)$ when $f=j_P(a)$. If $f=j_Q(b)$ too, then on a common refinement $R$ the two tuples agree, by injectivity of $j_R$, so compatibility makes the value independent of the representation. Represent two functions at a common refinement to check preservation of addition and multiplication; the constants check the unit and the $\Z$-algebra structure. Every function has a representative by step 1, so this is the unique algebra map satisfying $h\circ j_P=h_P$. Hence $B\cong\varinjlim_{P\in\mathcal P}B_P$, with a small filtered index category even when $S$ is empty.

source.place: First displayed formula: explicit colimit universal property

proof.text: The identity of $\Spec\Z$ is étale in [def-weil-etale-morphism]: it has the affine presentation with no generators or relations, its local-ring maps are identities (tensoring along one is the identity exact functor), and its diagonal is the identity open immersion. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-algebra-finite-product] to the finite family with every factor equal to $\Z$. It gives that $\Spec B_P\to\Spec\Z$ is étale, including the empty product, which is the zero ring. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-ring-map-iff-etale-affine], each $B_P$ is an étale $\Z$-algebra of finite presentation. The maps here are induced by the constant-function algebra maps, exactly the maps used in step 1.

source.place: Tag 00U2, lemma-etale (11); affine criterion Tag 02GJ, morphisms.tex lemma-etale-characterize (1) iff (2)

proof.text: Steps 2 and 3 give a presentation of $B$ as a small filtered colimit of finitely presented étale $\Z$-algebras. Therefore $\Z\to B$ is ind-étale by [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra]. This uses precisely the constant-function $\Z$-algebra structure on $LC(S,\Z)$, and does not assert that $B$ itself is finitely presented.

Apply the assertion “An ind-etale map is weakly etale” of [lem-weil-pbc-ind-etale-stability] to $\Z\to B$. By the affine scheme/ring equivalence explicitly contained in [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra], this says that the induced morphism $\Spec B\to\Spec\Z$ is weakly étale, with the scheme meaning fixed by [def-weil-weakly-etale-morphism]. In particular both the structure map and its diagonal are flat; the conclusion is not merely flatness of $B$ over $\Z$. Since the algebra map sends an integer to its constant function, its spectrum is the structure morphism in the statement. This also covers $S=\varnothing$, when $B=0$ and the source scheme is empty.
